items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: And Diggalane he played down on the other side right in the microphone.

ctx.x: All right, we were talking about WDSU. You.

Well, there was a man in the advertising business, Dick. His name was John...I can't think of his last name. John what? John Curran. No, uh-huh. Anyway, he was Shep Morrison's brother-in-law. Big old fella. Nice guy. And he gave me a ring about one o'clock in the day and said he needed a band or a try-off at WDSU. Parade of Bands. That was the name of the program was the Parade of Bands sponsored by Barnett Furniture Company. So, I told him I sure would. I'd like to play it. I get on the phone. I can't get in…
